segments.name: Vertically integrated, domestic rare earth element magnet production supply chai
segments.description: Integrated production of rare earth elements, metals, alloys and permanent magnets from mine to magnet for defense, manufacturing and technology applications.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single reportable operating segment; that segment being the vertically integrated, domestic rare earth element magnet production supply chain.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase casting and strip casting materials and rare earth products for advanced manufacturing, defense and technology applications.
revenueModel.evidence: All of the Company's revenue is derived from sales of casting and strip casting material based on the customers' "shipped to" address.

changes.text: In November 2025, the company acquired Less Common Metals Ltd., a producer of rare earth metals and alloys, integrating metal-making capabilities into its value chain.
changes.evidence: On November 18, 2025 ("Acquisition Date"), Laconia Acquisition Sub Limited ("Laconia"), our wholly owned subsidiary, acquired Indian Ocean Rare Metals Pte. Ltd. ("IORM"), the parent of Less Common Metals (also referred to as "LCM").
